sentences.text:
Learned counsel for the petitioners and learned High Court Government Pleader for respondent No.1-State and leaned counsel for respondent No.2-de-facto complainant are present.
2. Learned counsel for the petitioners has filed a memo dated 09.07.2024.

The contents of the said memo is as under:
"Herein, the advocate for the above named petitioners most respectfully submit as under.

That the, above petitioners filed this Writ Petition Under Article 226 and 227 of Constitution of India Row section 482 of Cr.P.C for quashing of FIR and Complaint registered against these petitioners by Mundgod Police Station in their P.S. Crime 239/2022 for the alleged offences punishable under section 323, 498A, 354, 504 and 506 R/w section 149 of 1.P.C and section 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
This Hon'ble Court after hearing granted Stay.

During the pendency of the above Writ Petition the complainant/Respondent No. 2 filed affidavit stating that, due to mental pressure filed the alleged complaint before the above Police Station and further, she stated that, she apologized the above petitioners and not NC: 2024:KHC-D:9499 interested to continue the further proceedings in the above case.
Hence, close the case.
The same is submitted before the P.I of Mundgod Police Station.
The copy of the same was sent to these petitioners also on 29/05/2024.

That, the above Writ Petition may kindly be allowed and quash the F.I.R and Complaint registered against the above petitioners by the Mundgod Police Station in their P.S Crime 239/2022 for the alleged offences punishable under section 323,
498A, 354, 504 and 506 R/w section 149 of I.P.C and section 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act pending on the file of Civil Judge and J.M.F.C Mundgod.
Hence, this memo"

3. Perused the petition and memo.
4.

The petitioners have filed this petition under Articles 226 and 227 of the Constitution of India read with section 482 of Cr.P.C. for quashing the FIR and complaint registered by Mundagod Police in Crime No.239/2022 for the offences punishable under Sections 323, 498A, 354(A), 504, 506 read with Section 149 of IPC and Sections 3 & 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.

During pendency of this petition, the de-facto complainant has filed an affidavit before the Investigating Officer stating that due to mental presser she filed the instant complaint and she also stated that she has no interest to continue the further proceedings.

The copies of the complaint and Abdul Munafs/O Abdul Sattar Mirjankar vs The State Of Karnataka on 9 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/115246543/
3 affidavit are produced before the Court.

sentences.text: 6. Perused the materials available on record, the de- facto complainant having agreed to withdraw the complaint registered against the petitioners, hence, it will be a futile exercise, if the petitioners are subjected to trial.
7. In view of the memo and in view of settlement arrived at between the parties, further prosecution against the petitioners is abuse of process of law.
Hence, the complaint and FIR requires to be quashed.
Hence, I pass the following.

: ORDER :
i.
The petition filed under Articles 226 & 227 of the Constitution of India read with Section 482 of Cr.P.C. is allowed.

The complaint and FIR in Crime No.239/2022 of Mundgod Police Station for the offences punishable under Sections 323, 498A,
354(A), 504, 506 read with Section 149 of IPC and Sections 3 & 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act are hereby quashed.
In view of the disposal of the petition, pending applications, if any, do not survive for consideration and accordingly the same are disposed off.
